# Animation Compression Library

Pinned upstream: [ACL v2.1.0](https://github.com/nfrechette/acl/releases/tag/v2.1.0), by Nicholas Frechette and contributors.

The unmodified `includes/` headers implement compression and decompression for the engine's native ACL adapter. ACL uses the sibling [RTM](../rtm/README.md) headers. The upstream MIT notice is in [LICENSE](LICENSE); native output and publish items carry both dependency notices.
